messages.subject: Calderdale House — completion statement and funds required
messages.plaintextBody:
Marcus,

Attached is the completion statement for 28 March. In short:

• Balance of purchase price due to seller: £7,756,996.15 (price £8.45m less the £845k deposit, plus net rent/service-charge apportionments, less the £29,250 Castleford rent deposit transferred to us)
• SDLT: £412,000
• HM Land Registry fee: £910
• Our fees and disbursements (est.): £24,600
• Total funds required from Ellwood Estates: £8,194,506.15

Please arrange for cleared funds to reach our client account by 27 March. The apportionments assume a 28 March completion; we'll reconfirm on the day.

Thanks,
Elena

—
Whitfield Carter LLP
22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
This email is confidential and may be legally privileged.
